name: mundoperfecto.net
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: mundoperfecto.net scores 72 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: 28 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 28 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /juego/, /aplicaciones/, /articles/ and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (1 request).
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, Claude-User cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /juego/, for example a[href$="play.google.com/"]. Impact: serious.

fix.title: 5 pages ask search engines not to index them
fix.evidence: /quienes-somos/ (noindex, follow), /politicas-privacidad-facebook/ (noindex, nofollow), /politica-de-cookies/ (noindex, nofollow), /politica-dmca/ (noindex, nofollow) and 1 more.
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /juego/, /aplicaciones/, for example .active. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 148 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
